description: Every .cook name a wallet owns, plus which one is its primary (the name apps show instead of the raw address). Defaults to the configured wallet; pass `wallet` to inspect any address or .cook name. Reads the registry on-chain — no indexer, no key needed.

wallet.description: wallet address or .cook name; omit to use the configured wallet

name: get_owned_domains
title: List a wallet's .cook names
